_comment: Copy this file to mcp.json in the same directory (it is gitignored) and fill in the values.
See docs/MCP.md for what each variable means.
AGENT_GROUPS_DATA is a DIRECTORY this MCP server owns. It holds memberships.json —
the credentials of the groups this client has joined. It is NOT the host's data
directory: pointing it at the host's ag-final-test makes every call fail with
unknown_group, because the ledger is keyed by the MCP connection id ("mcp") and the
host's own memberships are keyed by DSH session ids.

env.AGENT_GROUPS_TOKEN: <the api key AISIX issues to this caller>
env.AGENT_GROUPS_DATA: <a directory for this client's own memberships>
